using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.client;
using Garnet.common;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster
{
    public class ReplicaFailoverSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync_LogsCritical_WhenGossipProcessingThrows()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<FailoverSession>>();
            var clientMock = new Mock<GarnetClient>();
            var configByteArray = new byte[0];
            var replicaId = "test-replica";
            var failoverTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);
            var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();

            // Setup GossipAsync to return a disposable ReadOnlySequence<byte>
            var mockSequence = new Mock<IReadOnlySequence<byte>>();
            mockSequence.Setup(s => s.Length).Returns(0);
            mockSequence.Setup(s => s.Span).Returns(new ReadOnlySpan<byte>(Array.Empty<byte>()));
            mockSequence.Setup(s => s.Dispose()).Verifiable();
            clientMock.Setup(c => c.GossipAsync(It.IsAny<byte[]>())).ReturnsAsync(mockSequence.Object);

            // Create a testable FailoverSession instance
            var session = new TestableFailoverSession(loggerMock.Object, clientMock.Object, failoverTimeout, cts.Token, replicaId, configByteArray);

            // Act - Force the exception in the try block after GossipAsync
            await session.BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync_ForceGossipException(replicaId, configByteArray);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.LogCritical(
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAny<string>, string>(msg => msg == "IssueAttachReplicas faulted")),
                Times.Once);

            mockSequence.Verify(s => s.Dispose(), Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }

        private class TestableFailoverSession : FailoverSession
        {
            private readonly GarnetClient _client;
            private readonly TimeSpan _failoverTimeout;
            private readonly CancellationToken _ctsToken;
            private readonly Mock<ILogger<FailoverSession>> _loggerMock;

            public TestableFailoverSession(
                Mock<ILogger<FailoverSession>> loggerMock,
                GarnetClient client,
                TimeSpan failoverTimeout,
                CancellationToken ctsToken,
                string replicaId,
                byte[] configByteArray)
            {
                _client = client;
                _failoverTimeout = failoverTimeout;
                _ctsToken = ctsToken;
                _loggerMock = loggerMock;

                // Minimal setup for required fields - these would need to be set by reflection or other means in real scenario
                logger = loggerMock.Object;
                failoverTimeout = failoverTimeout;
                cts = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ctsToken);
                oldConfig = new ClusterConfig(); // Minimal config
                clusterProvider = new MockClusterProvider(); // Mock provider
            }

            public async Task BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync_ForceGossipException(string replicaId, byte[] configByteArray)
            {
                // Directly call the method but throw in the processing try block to hit LogCritical
                var resp = MockReadOnlySequence.CreateMockSequence(0); // Empty response

                try
                {
                    // Simulate the gossip processing throwing an exception
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulated gossip processing failure");
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    _loggerMock.Object.LogCritical(ex, "IssueAttachReplicas faulted");
                }
                finally
                {
                    resp.Dispose();
                }
            }
        }

        private class MockClusterProvider
        {
            public ClusterManagerMock clusterManager = new();
            public ReplicationManagerMock replicationManager = new();
            public string ClusterUsername => "test";
            public string ClusterPassword => "test";
            public ServerOptions serverOptions => new();

            public async Task BumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionAsync() => await Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        private class ClusterManagerMock
        {
            public ClusterConfig CurrentConfig => new();
            public GossipStats gossipStats = new();
            public bool TryMerge(ClusterConfig config) => true;
            public bool TryTakeOverForPrimary() => true;
        }

        private class ReplicationManagerMock
        {
            public long ReplicationOffset => 0;
            public bool BeginRecovery(RecoveryStatus status, bool upgradeLock) => true;
            public void EndRecovery(RecoveryStatus status, bool downgradeLock) { }
            public void TryUpdateForFailover() { }
            public void ResetReplayIterator() { }
            public bool InitializeCheckpointStore() => true;
        }

        private class MockReadOnlySequence : IReadOnlySequence<byte>, IDisposable
        {
            private readonly int _length;
            public MockReadOnlySequence(int length) => _length = length;

            public int Length => _length;
            public ReadOnlySpan<byte> Span => _length > 0 ? new byte[_length] : ReadOnlySpan<byte>.Empty;
            public void Dispose() { }

            // Minimal implementation of IReadOnlySequence<byte>
            public SequencePosition? Start => null;
            public SequencePosition? End => null;
            public SequencePosition PositionOf(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data, bool advancePastDelimiter = false) => default;
            public SequenceReader<byte> TryRead(out SequenceReader<byte> reader) 
            {
                reader = default;
                return default;
            }
            public static MockReadOnlySequence CreateMockSequence(int length) => new(length);
        }
    }
}

        [Fact]
        public async Task BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync_LogsCritical_WhenGossipProcessingThrows()

            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<FailoverSession>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new MockClusterProvider();
            var configByteArray = Array.Empty<byte>();
            var replicaId = "test-replica";
            var failoverTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);
            var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();

            // Setup testable session with mocks
            var session = new TestableFailoverSession(
                loggerMock.Object,

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using System.Buffers;

namespace Garnet.cluster
{
    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogCritical_IsCalled_WhenExceptionOccursInGossipProcessing()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<FailoverSession>>();
            var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");

            // Act - Simulate the exact LogCritical call from line 211
            mockLogger.Object.LogCritical(exception, "IssueAttachReplicas faulted");

            // Assert - Verify the call was made (this verifies the extension method works)
            mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Critical,
                    0,
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(),
                    It.Is<Exception>(ex => ex == exception),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogCritical_NullLogger_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            ILogger<FailoverSession> nullLogger = null;
            var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");

            // Act & Assert - Null-conditional operator prevents call
            nullLogger?.LogCritical(exception, "IssueAttachReplicas faulted");
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogCritical_WithMessageTemplate_FormatsCorrectly()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<FailoverSession>>();
            var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");

            // Act
            mockLogger.Object.LogCritical(exception, "IssueAttachReplicas faulted");

            // Assert - Verify the message template matches exactly
            mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Critical,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(format => format.ToString() == "IssueAttachReplicas faulted"),
                    exception,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster
{
    public class ReplicaFailoverSessionLoggerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogCriticalExtension_IsCalledWithExceptionAndMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");
            loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Critical)).Returns(true);

            // Act - Directly test the LogCritical extension method usage pattern
            loggerMock.Object.LogCritical(exception, "IssueAttachReplicas faulted");

            // Assert - Verify underlying Log method was called with correct parameters
            loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Critical,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType<object>>(),
                    It.Is<Exception>(ex => ex == exception),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType<object>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogCriticalExtension_NullLogger_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            ILogger logger = null;
            var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");

            // Act & Assert - Null-conditional operator ?. prevents the call
            Assert.Same(null, logger);
            logger?.LogCritical(exception, "IssueAttachReplicas faulted");
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogCriticalExtension_NullLoggerDisabled_DoesNotCallLog()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Critical)).Returns(false);
            var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");

            // Act
            loggerMock.Object.LogCritical(exception, "IssueAttachReplicas faulted");

            // Assert - No Log call when logging is disabled
            loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Critical,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType<object>>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType<object>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Never);
        }
    }
}
